start: Gym tab, 'My gym' part, joined gym with bring-a-friend live (0056), online, gym gives 7 free days per friend

steps.action: Open the Gym tab and the 'My gym' part, scroll to the card
user_sees: Card titled 'Bring a friend'
'Send a friend a link to your gym. They leave their number, and the gym calls them.'
'When a friend joins, your gym can add 7 free days to your plan.'
'Friends who joined: 0'
must_not: '1 days' for a one-day reward
Names or numbers of the friends who asked

user_sees: The phone's share menu with 'Come and train with me at <gym>! Leave your name and number on this page, and the gym will call you: <link with own code>'
must_not: Another member's code in the link
The share menu opening twice

start: Gym tab, 'My gym' part, member who left the gym or the gym is paused (server answers LEFT / SUSPENDED)

user_sees: No 'Bring a friend' card at all; the rest of the part as usual
must_not: A card with a dead link
An error box about the invite

start: Gym tab, 'My gym' part, phone offline (or server without 0056)

steps.action: Open the 'My gym' part with no internet
user_sees: No 'Bring a friend' card (it needs the code from the server)
must_not: A card with an empty or made-up code outside a QA build
An endless spinner

steps.action: Turn the internet on and pull to refresh
user_sees: The card appears with the member's own code
must_not: The card staying hidden for the app's life after one offline miss (only a missing-server answer is remembered)

start: Card shown with 'Friends who joined: 0'; a friend uses the link and the desk marks the enquiry joined

steps.action: Leave the Gym tab and come back (or pull to refresh)
user_sees: 'Friends who joined: 1'
must_not: The count going up when the friend only left a number but did not join
The friend's name shown

steps.action: Desk later changes that enquiry away from joined, come back
user_sees: The count goes back down
must_not: A count that never goes down

start: Member shares the link; friend fills the page

steps.action: Friend opens the link and leaves name and number
user_sees: The friend shows in the gym's enquiries with the member's name; the member's card shows only the count
must_not: The member seeing the friend's number or name
The friend's details reaching another gym
